title: Explainable machine learning models predicting the risk of social isolation in older adults: a prospective cohort study.
summary: A prospective cohort models social-isolation risk in older adults using CHARLS; 6,588 participants support development/internal validation and later follow-up testing. Interpret as population-specific risk prediction. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
